subject: Acme Fasteners is moving to electronic invoicing
text:
Dear Customer,

Beginning December 1, Acme Fasteners LLC invoices will be delivered through our new e-invoicing platform. Invoices will arrive from noreply@einvoice.acmefasteners.com as PDF attachments with the same layout as today.

Please add that address to your safe-sender list. Payment terms, remittance instructions and your account number are not changing.

Acme Fasteners LLC
label: ordinary
note: Invoice delivery change with an explicit statement that remittance is unchanged.
